exposure: expectant management of prolonged pregnancies (proportion of pregnancies >= 42+3 gestational weeks among all pregnancies >= 41+3 weeks > 17.6%)
active management of prolonged pregnancies (proportion of pregnancies >= 42+3 gestational weeks among all pregnancies >= 41+3 weeks < 12.6%)
cohort: The study included 199,770 singleton cephalic prolonged pregnancies (defined as >= 41+3 gestational weeks) from the Swedish Medical Birth Register between 2001-2013.
finding: Among primiparous women, active management of prolonged pregnancies was associated with a decreased risk of Apgar score < 7 at 5 minutes and meconium aspiration, but no such association was found for multiparous women.
mod_finding: Expectant management was associated with a decreased rate of cesarean section for both primiparous and multiparous women.
